gates.name: AgentDash local authority
gates.pass_criteria: Exact observed loopback, same-origin command session, durable nonce persistence, and one controller owner.
gates.no_go_behavior: Board remains read-only; activation and dispatch are denied.

gates.name: Hermes atomicity
gates.pass_criteria: Lifetime task identity, digest artifacts, action-command/run CAS, and terminal-event support.
gates.no_go_behavior: Cards may be mocked; authoritative lifecycle mutation is denied.

gates.name: CodeG replay safety
gates.pass_criteria: Unique ensure, definitive lookup, cursor transcript, and exact identity/cancel/runtime/activity facts.

gates.name: PM isolation
gates.pass_criteria: Live inventory and side-effect probes demonstrate zero worker capability.
gates.no_go_behavior: PM surface is disabled; only typed fixture proposals are permitted.

gates.name: Workspace containment
gates.pass_criteria: Canonical real path equals the configured CodeG folder for every mutation.

gates.name: Route qualification
gates.pass_criteria: Current level-5 evidence exists for the exact route and task-class with no substitution.
gates.no_go_behavior: Exact pair is unavailable; silent substitution is denied.

gates.name: Budget enforcement
gates.pass_criteria: Aggregate worst case and one-time reserves are enforceable for automatic and approval dispatch.
gates.no_go_behavior: Automatic and approval dispatch are both denied.

gates.name: Verification independence
gates.pass_criteria: Every success-capable path has a valid independent tier verifier.

gates.name: Finalization exactness
gates.pass_criteria: Mutation and expected post-state are bound, CAS-safe, and reconcilable.

gates.name: Reconciliation
gates.pass_criteria: Every uncertain operation exits Working by a positive numeric deadline and unresolved uncertainty becomes inconsistent.
gates.no_go_behavior: Dispatch health is not ready; existing uncertainty ends inconsistent.
